summary: Phase 2.5A+B — Financeiro overhaul FULLY GREEN. 23/23 backend pytest cases PASS covering RBAC (admin/financeiro write, recepcao read-only, profissional 403, super_admin read), non-destructive PUT (only sent fields change; paid_at auto-populates/clears), filters (type/paid/patient_id/date_from-to/installment_group_id/search + combos), schema defaults (installment_group_id=entry_id, installment_number=1, installment_total=1 when omitted; paid_at on create), intelligent installments end-to-end via /attendance/{sid}/finalize for nao_pago (6 parcelas, same grp_ id, due dates +30d, amounts sum to total, professional_id/procedure_id keys present), parcial (1 entrada installment_number=0 + N parcelas), pago (1 entry with paid_at), backward-compat default installments=1. Budget public approval sets status=aprovado + pending_charge_generation=true and does NOT auto-create financial entries. POST /budgets/{id}/generate-charges creates N entries and is idempotent (returns already_generated=true both when re-called and when a manual entry with the budget_id already exists). Dashboard revenue_month + /finance/summary shape regression OK. Frontend /financeiro loads for admin with KPIs, chart, entries list; new entry via dialog creates and appears; togglePaid PATCH via badge updates status in place without wiping context fields. No console errors, no design breakages.

minor.issue: FinancialEntryIn accepts arbitrary strings in 'category' (intentional per user approval — flagged only for awareness).
?paid boolean is parsed by FastAPI Query — accepts 'true'/'false'/'1'/'0'. Works fine; noting it's not strictly enforced.

Idempotency key is the presence of ANY entry with matching budget_id — even a single manual entry (any amount) blocks generation. Intentional per audit but flag: could confuse users if a manual expense/receita accidentally uses budget_id.
When payload is omitted entirely, no financial entries are created (silent). Existing behavior — not a bug — but observers may want a status flag.

issues: A11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking — recommend adding DialogDescription for screen-reader parity.

Console warnings 'width(-1)/height(-1) of chart should be > 0' during first paint. Only during initial mount. Consider giving the ResponsiveContainer parent an explicit minHeight or fixed height on first render.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription to Novo Lançamento dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
OPTIONAL: Restrict FinancialEntryIn.category to a known enum or add server-side normalization (user approved free-string, so this is purely quality-of-life).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:807-831 update_entry — CORRECT non-destructive PATCH using data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True); paid_at bookkeeping is symmetric (set when paid=True, cleared when paid=False).

server.py:1632-1711 finalize_attendance installment engine — correctly clamps to [1..48], divides evenly with remainder absorbed by the last parcela, uses timedelta arithmetic for due dates, and shares a single grp_ installment_group_id across all parcels of a given payment. Entrada (parcial with amount_paid>0) is correctly numbered installment_number=0.

server.py:1880-1885 generate_charges_from_budget — idempotency by 'any entry with same budget_id exists' is broad but user-approved. Consider tightening to 'entries created by generate-charges' via a source flag if the manual-entry-with-budget_id false-positive becomes a real issue.
server.py:2449-2458 require_finance_read/write — clean role gates. recepcao read-only, admin+financeiro write, profissional excluded. Matches spec.
server.py file is 4112 lines — still deserves a router/services split; not a 2.5 blocker.
Financeiro.jsx:48-53 togglePaid — now correctly sends ONLY {paid: !entry.paid}. Prior full-body PUT was wiping context; the fix is verified end-to-end.
CompletePaymentDialog.jsx — installments block only visible when status !== 'pago' (correct); intervalDays default 30 and installments default 1 match backend defaults.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Financeiro load + create + toggle-paid + KPIs + chart + entries list all working)

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral finance entries (all TEST_-prefixed), appointments/attendance sessions, and budgets — every one is deleted or ignored on teardown. UI test also created a 'TEST_UI_ENTRY_ZZ' entry and toggled one existing 'Teste Parcelamento parcela 6/6' badge; both side effects were reverted via API after the UI run (entry deleted, badge restored to paid=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.5A+B backend is 100% green (RBAC + non-destructive PUT + installment engine + generate-charges idempotency + filters + dashboard/summary regression). Frontend Financeiro renders all KPIs/chart/entries and togglePaid uses the fixed PATCH-style body. Next iteration can safely build on these guarantees: (a) FinancialEntryIn schema accepts free-string category by design; (b) installment_group_id auto-populates to entry_id for single entries; (c) generate-charges idempotency triggers on ANY entry sharing the budget_id (broad by design). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_5_finance.py can be reused as regression for future finance changes.
